items.followUp: How many elements are present in the second and third periods of the periodic table?

rubric.description: Names the second and third periods as normal periods.

rubric.why: States the number of elements in each normal period.
rubric.description: States that each contains eight elements.
rubric.how: Award for stating the correct number.

modelAnswer: The second and third periods are considered normal periods.

items.followUp: What is the transition temperature of sulfur, and which change occurs at that temperature?

rubric.why: Defines transition temperature as the temperature at which one allotropic form changes into another.
rubric.description: Gives the definition of transition temperature.

rubric.why: Gives the sulfur example, including its temperature and the two forms.
rubric.description: States that rhombic sulfur changes into monoclinic sulfur at about 96°C.
rubric.how: Award for the correct temperature and both forms.

modelAnswer: Transition temperature is the temperature at which one allotropic form of a substance changes into another.
For example, at about 96°C, rhombic sulfur changes into monoclinic sulfur.
